messages:
Sam: @team quick microcopy pass for two things: 1) empty state on dashboard when there are no runs, 2) token-cost tooltip in the console. Pastes below — react with :1: or :2: or comment.

Sam: Empty state options:
```
1) "No model runs yet — start a test run to see results and usage graphs."
2) "Your dashboard is empty. Run a model to populate results and cost insights."
3) "Nothing to show yet. Create a test run or upload a dataset to get started."
```

Sam: Tooltip variants for token cost breakdown (short):
```
A) "Token cost: tokens used × model rate. Includes cached tokens."
B) "Cost per token for this request. Applies after batching and discounts."
C) "Estimated token charge for this response (does not include credits)."
```

Ava: I like Empty 3 for onboarding clarity. "Create a test run" is actionable — can we use that phrase as the CTA? :+1:

Priya: Frontend notes: tooltips should be <= 120 chars and ideally a single line. A and C are fine; B is too wordy. Also keep sentence case and avoid abbreviations like "excl.".

Marco: Accessibility nit: tooltips must map to aria-describedby and be keyboard-focusable. For empty states, include an offscreen heading like "No runs on this project" for screen readers. Avoid vague phrasing like "Nothing to show".

Jordan: Tone guidance: friendly but concise. For delete confirmation dialogs we should be explicit. Proposed copy:
```
Title: "Delete run?"
Body: "Deleting this run permanently removes all logs and metrics. This action cannot be undone."
Primary: "Delete run"  Secondary: "Cancel"
```

Sam: Updated comps below — please quick thumbs or flag. I'll push to Figma and add i18n keys after consensus.

Sam: Final empty state (proposed): "Your dashboard is empty. Create a test run to see results and cost insights." CTA label: "Create test run"  aria-label: "Create a test run"

Sam: Final tooltip (proposed): "Estimated token cost for this request (does not include credits)." — 92 chars, single line.

Marco: Looks good. Also add aria-live="polite" on the toast after a run is created so screen readers announce new content.

Ava: Approved for next sprint grooming. Please include the i18n keys and max char validations in the ticket. :rocket:
